spanish: o se le hiciere saber su pecado que pecó en ella, y traerá su ofrenda, macho cabrío de cabras, macho íntegro.

findings.issue: Hophal perfect (completed passive of knowing) is rendered as hypothetical subjunctive hiciere, so the clause reads as contingency rather than a completed being-made-known.

notes: או, אליו, חטאתו, אשר חטא בה, והביא, קרבנו, שעיר עזים, זכר, and תמים are otherwise matched, including the feminine בה as en ella.
